lessons.claim: [L] Leal's frame (a) does not treat microrheology or GSER at all (0 hits in a full-text search) and (b) does not treat active matter -- because the thermodynamic component is defined as 'the mechanism that returns it to equilibrium' and (2.18)-(2.19) presuppose no external torque. So abp-rod is outside this book's frame, and our using <cos dtheta> instead of pe_per_particle was the practical reflection of that fact. It neither conflicts with nor supports our GSER-invalid conclusion (a different subject)
